limitations: Run groups 2, 3, 5, 6 in the experiment names presumably correspond to the four conditions (mock/LPS at 3 h and 6 h) described in the paper (Fig. 3a), but no deposited file or text maps group numbers to conditions; treatment and sampling time are therefore 'not available' and no factor value is given. The group number is kept in the source name.

Biological replicate numbers 1-5 are assigned by the label order HC2 A, HC2 B, HC2 C, HC7, HC exp1 (HC1 in RS) based on consistent naming and the paper's five biological replicates; the deposit does not confirm that A/B/C are independent biological replicates or that HC exp1 equals HC1.
HCAECs are primary cells (PromoCell); the cell-lines template was not used. Donor age, sex and disease status are not given; marked 'not available'.

Missing P-numbers (P8528, P8534, P8540, ...) are not deposited and not claimed. The two archives txt_EV.zip and txt_RS.zip (listed by range read on the central directory) hold only MaxQuant output tables.

Collision energy, alkylation/reduction reagents and LC column/gradient details per fraction were not extracted (RAW methods differ between EV: 50 cm column and RS: 25 cm column per embedded method path); only recorded here. Acquisition method DDA is assumed from the MaxQuant label-free workflow, not read from the RAW method.
A community-annotated SDRF is present in the deposit; it was not consulted.
